request.description: `launch` flashes the firmware and resets the target; `attach` connects to a running target without resetting it.

executable.description: ELF file of the firmware (with debug info). Relative paths are resolved against `cwd`. Example: "build/firmware.elf".

cwd.description: Working directory for relative paths and the GDB server. Defaults to the project root.

serverType.description: GDB server to start: OpenOCD, ST-LINK_gdbserver (STM32CubeIDE/CubeCLT), st-util, pyOCD, SEGGER J-Link, QEMU, or `external` for an already running server (see `gdbTarget`).

serverPath.description: Path to the GDB server program (default: found in PATH / standard install locations).

serverArgs.description: Extra command line arguments for the GDB server.

serverEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the GDB server.

serverReadyText.description: Text in the server output that means it accepts GDB connections (overrides the built-in detection).

serverTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the GDB server to become ready.

gdbTarget.description: host:port of the GDB server; required for `serverType: external`, e.g. "localhost:3333".

port.description: GDB port for a server started by Haltline (default: a free port).

gdbPath.description: GDB to use (default: arm-none-eabi-gdb or gdb-multiarch from PATH or the STM32CubeCLT / Arm GNU toolchain folders).

configFiles.description: OpenOCD configuration files (-f), e.g. ["interface/stlink.cfg", "target/stm32f4x.cfg"]. Optional when `device` is a known STM32.

openocdCommands.description: Extra OpenOCD commands (-c), run after the configuration files.

probe.description: Debug probe, used to choose the OpenOCD interface file when `configFiles` is not set.

device.description: Device part number, e.g. "STM32F407VG". Used for the OpenOCD target file, J-Link and pyOCD.

serialNumber.description: Serial number of the probe to use when several are connected.

machine.description: QEMU machine (-M), e.g. netduinoplus2, olimex-stm32-h405, stm32vldiscovery.

stm32cubeprogrammer.description: STM32CubeProgrammer `bin` directory, needed by ST-LINK_gdbserver (found automatically in STM32CubeCLT).

rtos.description: OpenOCD RTOS awareness (`auto`, `FreeRTOS`, `Zephyr`, ...): tasks are shown as threads.

semihosting.description: Enable semihosting (printf to the debug console through the debugger) in OpenOCD, st-util, pyOCD or QEMU.

svdFile.description: CMSIS-SVD file of the MCU; enables the Peripherals view (registers and bit fields). Example: "STM32F407.svd".

runToEntryPoint.description: Function to run to after launch and restart; empty string to disable.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop right after reset (in Reset_Handler) instead of running to `runToEntryPoint`.

loadImage.description: Flash `executable` on launch (default: true, false for QEMU).

verifyAfterLoad.description: After flashing, compare the target memory with `executable` (GDB `compare-sections`) and fail the launch on a mismatch.

continueOnAttach.description: Let the target keep running after attaching.

preLaunchCommands.description: GDB commands run after connecting, before reset and flashing.

postLaunchCommands.description: GDB commands run after flashing and reset.

overrideLaunchCommands.description: Replace the whole launch sequence (reset, load, reset) with these GDB commands.

preAttachCommands.description: GDB commands run after connecting in attach mode.

postAttachCommands.description: GDB commands run at the end of attaching.

overrideAttachCommands.description: Replace the attach sequence with these GDB commands.

preRestartCommands.description: GDB commands run before the reset on restart.

postRestartCommands.description: GDB commands run after the reset on restart.

overrideRestartCommands.description: Replace the restart sequence with these GDB commands.

resetCommands.description: Commands that reset and halt the target (default depends on the server, e.g. `monitor reset halt`).

reloadOnRestart.description: Flash the executable again when the session is restarted (useful after rebuilding).

showDisassembly.description: When the current frame is shown as disassembly: `auto` = when stepping by instruction (Zed setting debugger.stepping_granularity = "instruction") or when there is no source.

hexValues.description: Show variable values in hexadecimal (toggle at runtime with `:hex` in the debug console).

showGlobals.description: Show the Globals and Static scopes.

debugOutput.description: Log every GDB/MI command and response to the debug console.

adapterPath.description: Use this haltline-dap binary instead of the downloaded one.
